1.5 - Intrinsically Safe and SECTION 1.5
Explosion Proof Equipment (For Tankers) REV. NO. 2.0

Cable connections, termination and grounding are to be checked and made good as per below illustrations.

Proper cable gland is to be used and the gaps in the cable inside the terminal box/junction box should be
sealed with suitable dielectric epoxy compound to prevent ingress of the explosive/toxic gases.

The wire/cable should be properly crimped in the
connection lugs

“0” Ring

Flange Joint Spigot Joint Screwed Joint

The flange mating faces should be properly cleaned and apply Vaseline. The O-rings/gaskets should be
renewed if damaged. Ensure there are no missing bolts on the cover. If the terminal box is threaded type,
the threads should be cleaned and lightly lubricated with greased and tightened to ensure proper sealing.
